_comment: Tasmota parameters for the Sengled W31-N13H, verified on real bulbs (Tasmota 16.0.0). Used by w31n13h.py configure/calibrate. VirtualCT is not persisted by Tasmota, so the tool also writes Rule3 (ON System#Boot DO VirtualCT ...).

pins.GPIO4: PWM4 - warm white (the only white LED)

tested_cold_white_values.F8E2B480: default - neutral cold white, white LED at 50% (bulb #1)
tested_cold_white_values.F8EAB480: same with a bit more green, for a bulb that looked slightly pink (bulb #2)
